crisis_sg.text:
It sounds like you may be going through something really painful, and you deserve support from a person right now. I'm a university prototype, not a counsellor, so please reach out to one of these:

- If you might act on these thoughts or are in danger, call 995 or go to the nearest hospital Emergency Department (A&E).
- Samaritans of Singapore (SOS): call 1767 or WhatsApp 9151 1767, 24 hours.
- national mindline 1771: call 1771 or WhatsApp 6669 1771, 24 hours.

If you can, please also let someone you trust know how you are feeling.

sources.details: 995, or a hospital Emergency Department (A&E), if at risk of immediate harm

sources.service: national mindline 1771 (MOH National Mental Health Office)
sources.details: call 1771; WhatsApp +65 6669 1771; web chat on mindline.sg; 24/7; not toll-free

crisis_sg.excluded: IMH Mental Health Helpline 6389 2222 is no longer listed on IMH's contact page, which directs 24/7 mental health support to national mindline 1771 (https://www.nhghealth.com.sg/imh/about-us/contact-us, checked 2026-10-15).
